description: List distinct CMS ProviderInfo values and counts for a field. Omit field to see the catalog. Use field=ownership before search_facilities to get the 13 ownership types. city requires state.

field.description: ProviderInfo field. Omit to list allowed fields. ownership is the search_facilities filter.

filedate.description: Optional CMS monthly snapshot (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Defaults to the latest file. Call list_file_dates first for available dates.

state.description: Optional two-letter state. Required when field=city.

name: list_distinct_values
